messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — kicking off Aurora10b onboarding intake. Goal: bring up hosted API + dedicated pool + optional private VPC. Need prioritization for evals, quant experiments, and rollout checklist. Anyone free to triage risks this afternoon?
ashok: I can take quant/latency experiments. Do we have baseline perf and quality for the Aurora checkpoints?
maria.g: Quick baseline (from perf harness):
```
model: aurora10b
fp16 p50: 120ms p95: 420ms
cpu-embeds: 0.9ms/token
baseline perplexity: 12.3 (eval-set A)
embedding cosine avg vs prod-embed: 0.985
```
Also dropped sample eval shards to Google Drive (link obv).
elaine: I'll own regressions/evals. Suggest we run the full QA suite + 2 targeted regression suites (summarization + instruction-following). Pass criteria: no significant drop vs baseline: delta ROUGE <= 1.5, instruction failure rate < 1%.
carter: For rollout, propose staged plan: Hosted canary (5% traffic, 1h), escalate to 20% (6h) -> 100% next day if green. Dedicated bring-up behind a reserved pool with 0 traffic until smoke probes pass. Private deploys require a separate checklist (network, KMS, audit).
nashok: Quant plan: int8 CUDA + int8 A10X path, then int4 PTQ on dedicated nodes. Metrics to collect: p95 latency, token throughput, KL divergence on logits, and eval quality delta. If int8 quality drop < 0.8% and latency improves 1.5x, mark as candidate.
maria.g: Agreed. Also: routing/fallbacks — map hosted->fallback to a smaller fp16 variant (aurora-lite-6b) if errors spike or latency SLO violated. Dedicated fallback: spill to next region. Private: customer policy defined.
elaine: Smoke tests (to run pre-canary):
- short prompt stability x100 (no hangs)
- chat-turn continuity (KV cache integrity)
- embed drift spot-check (100 queries)
- safety filter regression (10k prompts)
If any fail, stop and roll back.
carter: I'll create canary route and traffic split. deploy-bot: /create-canary aurora10b hosted traffic=5m->0.05 (placeholder)
deploy-bot: Canary route created: aurora10b-hosted-canary id=cnb-2134, status=PENDING.
maria.g: Who's on pager for the canary window? Need 2 on-call eng-ml + one on-call perf.
ashok: I'll be on call for quant metrics. carter: I'll watch infra + scaling. elaine: QA on regs.
elaine: Also recommend these automations for the canary:
- auto-fallback if p95 > 300ms for 3 consecutive 5-min windows
- failover on 0.5% error rate spike
- auto-roll-forward only after regression checks pass
Add monitoring alerts to Redwood Console and dashboard.
maria.g: Decision: Start hosted canary tomorrow 09:00 PST with 5% traffic for 1h. Concurrently run int8 experiments on dedicated staging. Private onboarding dependent on customer sign-off. Owners: hosted+rollout = carter, quant+perf = ashok, evals+regs = elaine.
carter: I'll create the checklist ticket and add those thresholds + dashboard links. ETA 2h.
maria.g: Great. Follow-ups: post canary logs in this thread and tag @eng-oncall if alerts trigger. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
_notes: This thread captures a short intake/triage discussion for a new model onboarding, with owners, quick baselines, quant plan, smoke tests, and rollout/fallback rules.
